integrity: Classical Stirling enumeration and Pavlov's fixed-component half-normal local law are explicitly acknowledged as prior work; the focus is the modal asymptotic and finite log-concavity. Theoretical proof and independent finite verifier are included.
scientific_limitations: Uniform maps only; fixed component count; the modal asymptotic is first-order; exact small-sample ties are not classified. Full text of two plausible older publications could not be inspected, so historical priority requires independent review.
title: An anomalous modal scale for cyclic vertices in fixed-component random mappings
